headline: Japan's Rapidus Eligible for ¥54 Billion Tax Exemption on Hokkaido Plant Transfer
summary: Government-backed chipmaker Rapidus may receive a ¥54 billion tax exemption when transferring its Hokkaido plant to a state agency in 2027 in exchange for equity shares.
why: Rapidus is Japan's state-supported enterprise striving to mass-produce next-generation 2-nanometer semiconductors.
